scope: STATIC SOURCE ENDPOINTS ONLY. No generated frames, continuous motion, song synchronization, final edit, or full scene acceptance.

inspection.note: Scratch FFmpeg-only crops are review aids at native scale, not production inputs. New operator crops must preserve reviewed functional content and be bound to their own exact bytes.

pairs.observed: Established rehearsal setting and black-clothed Jaro read as subjective performance. Partly curled RIGHT hand opens near chest; inward posture/gaze lifts into breath, fear rather than triumph.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Microphone angle drifts slightly between drawings: generated hardware must remain rigid and supported, not bend or wobble autonomously. Fine vocal timing requires the original exact song excerpt. The images do not prove lip synchronization.

pairs.observed: Closer first-plea source begins already distressed/open-vowel and ends with breath spent/mouth narrower; coherent identity, torso and low open right-hand gesture. No aggressive interaction with the woman or hospital is depicted.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: End hand descends partly below the intentional close-up crop. Accept only a coherent visible lowering and natural frame exit, not proof of the entire final hand pose/contact. First scream must be full-force from its actual onset, with original-audio timing; inspect jaw/neck/hands and microphone rigidity in generated motion.

authority: Root owns canon/contract changes. Artist and reviewer are separate. No generator or GPU operation performed by reviewer.
